note: The Burton household at The Bungalow, 10 Lenton Road, on the 1911 return, transcribed again by A. Hagues. All ten were already in the record at 10 Lenton Road (#363), so every person here is bound by number and nothing new is created. The importer fills blanks only: this adds each birthplace and Jaqueline's birth year (1911, age 0 on the return). It cannot change a name or a value already held, so the differences between this transcription and the record are listed for correcting by hand: Clifford F / Clifford G (#906), Georgianna A / Georgina A (#908), Jaqueline G / Jaqueline F (#909), Gertrude B Keightley / Gertrude V Reightley (#913), and George A Burton (#904) is recorded as female. Wright's Directory of Nottingham confirms The Bungalow is number 10: 1910-11 lists George Anthony Burton, director of Joseph Burton & Sons, at 10 Lenton Road, and 1913-14 and 1915-16 print '10 The Bungalow'. By 1913-14 the Burtons are at 5 Cavendish Crescent North.
source: 1911 census, The Bungalow, Lenton Road, transcribed by A. Hagues. Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1910-11 (Leicester Special Collections id 165799), 1913-14 (id 166496), 1915-16 (id 347783).
